audit.whatIsWrong: All seven rows disagreed across layers: full-layer phases[].side read Pantheon on every row while content win[] read Orianna/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Orianna.
audit.why: The content layer matches the packet levelChart and the 50.59% win rate over 1,269 games. Level 1 is Orianna's because Shield Vault is not available until 2 and Comet Spear is 575 range; levels 2 through first item are a genuine skill fight between a 13s point-click stun-dash and Q-W spacing; two-plus items go to Orianna because Pantheon is a single-target diver against a five-man Shockwave.
audit.corrected: Full layer moved onto the content values, ratings 7/5/5/5/5/5/7, every why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.why: Spikes are placed right: Pantheon's level 2 Shield Vault is the real lane spike, level 6 Grand Starfall (180/165/150, 5500 range) is map pressure rather than a solo-kill spike, and Orianna's two-item teamfight spike is where the matchup turns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important kit interaction in this matchup was nowhere on the page: Aegis Assault makes Pantheon invulnerable to damage from the FRONT only, and it is a channel that CC ends. breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit in it at all.
audit.why: Riot's E text: he sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front, and the kit flags it channel (interruptible). That means your Q ball landing behind him and your Shockwave knockup both beat it, while poking into his face for 22 seconds does nothing. Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9 at 600 range and is flagged autoReset, so the burst is stun plus Comet Spear plus a reset auto.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, phases[2].why, phases[6].why, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.carry now carry the front-only invulnerability, the knockup cancel, and the real 13s/22s/180s numbers.
sources: brief enemyKit E text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d claimed a fifteen-second invitation when Shield Vault is spent.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1 and 9s at rank 5. Fifteen seconds is not a number in this kit at any rank.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] verbed the ability name - "the instant he Shield Vaults" - which the packet flagged as a probable wrong name.
audit.why: The ability is Shield Vault. Turning it into a verb reads as a different ability to someone scanning the page.
audit.corrected: wants.you[0] now says "the instant he casts Shield Vault". The packet also flagged "Shield Vault's" in content.mid; that is a correct possessive of the correct name and was left alone.

notes: All seven chart rows disagreed across layers (full said Pantheon on every row, content said Orianna/Skill x5/Orianna); the full layer was moved onto the content layer, which the packet levelChart and the 50.59% win rate both support. No paired win[N] edits are proposed because win[N] already holds the correct value on disk. The decisive kit fact - Aegis Assault blocks damage from the FRONT only and is an interruptible channel - was absent from the entire page and is now stated in breakdown.cooldowns, phases[2].why, phases[6].why, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.carry. The packet's second suspectName, "Shield Vault's" in content.mid, is a false positive: it is a correct possessive and was left alone. breakdown.wave and breakdown.late remain structurally templated Orianna boilerplate; nothing in Pantheon's kit grounds a replacement without inventing, so they were left.
